_meta.name: SX7 Sexual Seven — Clean Confirmation (v2)
_meta.description: Sexual Seven, SX instinct flavor (NOT a genuine counter-type — SO-7 is the Seven counter-type). Stage 1 raw slider profile leads Type 7 with Type 5 as closest alternate; SX instinct dominant by a wide margin. Stage 2 evidence is Assertive / Positive / Facts-first. Stage 3 ran STANDARD (5 vs 7), clean lean to Type 7 (Person B). Stage 4 Option A confirmed cleanly. AI Call #1 leads Type 7 with no counter-type pair (frozen in call1Result). Call #2 returns confirmed_type 7, HIGH confidence. NOTE: Call #2 currently emits a counter_type flag on the SX instinct-flavor distinction — accepted behavior, asserted as-is; prompt tightening is a Step 7 punch-list item. Section presence is NOT asserted (section1a flickers run-to-run for the same reason). Call #2 is the unit under test.

stage0Answers.q1: enthusiastic, curious, always chasing what's interesting — I love deep conversations and exploring ideas with people I find genuinely fascinating
stage0Answers.q2: fun, energetic, a bit scattered, good at starting things and inspiring others but not always at following through
stage0Answers.q3: seeing possibilities everywhere and getting the people I care about excited about them
stage0Answers.q4: I avoid discomfort and difficult emotions — I reframe or escape rather than sitting with what's hard

stage1TypeOpen: Once I lock onto a person or an idea I find electric, everything else drops away — I want to go all the way in, fast and intense. The hard part is when the spark fades and I'm already scanning for the next thing that lights me up.
stage1InstinctOpen: It's all about intensity and chemistry for me. A conversation, a project, a connection — if there's no charge to it I lose interest almost instantly, and when there is I'll pour everything into it.

call1Result.supporting_language: seeing possibilities everywhere and getting the people I care about excited about them — combined with being 'good at starting things and inspiring others but not always at following through'
